page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing predictable compute allocation. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance type does not include any bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating systems and data. It does not feature any GPU acceleration. Additionally, the CPU configuration does not expose advanced instruction set extensions such as AVX, AVX-512, AMX, or hardware-accelerated cryptography flags like AES-NI.

Given its dedicated 2-core compute profile and 8.0 GB of RAM, the ecs.s2.xlarge is positioned as a cost-efficient entry-level option for workloads requiring stable, non-burstable CPU performance without the overhead of high-density memory or specialized hardware. It is suitable for lightweight web serving, basic application hosting, small databases, and development or testing environments that do not rely on vector or matrix acceleration.
